newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk unit may face bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk unit may face bankruptcy.

text.p: Russia's Norilsk Nickel flagship metals combine could face bankruptcy if it does not issue shares, Interfax news agency quoted First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin as saying on Tuesday.

He said the government would propose on Friday that Norilsk issue shares to raise capital for its debt and that if the company did not agree with the proposal, it would be turned over to a special tax commission which could institute bankruptcy proceedings.
